response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with strong web, backend, and tooling credentials, but the profile does not match this embedded networking security role. There is no evidence of Japanese language ability (a hard requirement), no Linux kernel analysis or source modification experience, no L2/L3 networking, switch chip, or security protocol work (MACsec, 802.1X, captive portal), and C experience is limited to a short stint at National Instruments over a decade ago. The dominant stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, web/GIS) is orthogonal to embedded firmware development for LAN switches.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across many domains
Some C/C++ exposure (NI LabWindows/CVI) and Linux/systems familiarity
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, open-source leadership
concerns: No Japanese proficiency; requirement is native-level
No embedded firmware, Linux kernel, or switch/networking experience
Security domain knowledge (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption) absent from resume
